messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY in German Reich (1871-1945) during the 1900s and 1910s and 1920s, matching this research need: historical German labor market policy data on employment services, job creation, and unemployment compensation, including unemployment rates, vacancies, union benefits, and public labor exchanges during the Kaiserreich, especially 1890–1918
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
